Baby Cost Calculator

Estimate first-year baby costs from editable monthly and one-time line items.

Monthly items are multiplied by 12; one-time items are added once.

For information only — not financial advice. Costs vary widely by location and choices.

📖 How to use

  1. Review the default line items and edit any monthly or one-time cost.
  2. Add your own items or remove ones that do not apply.
  3. Monthly items are multiplied by 12 automatically.
  4. Read the estimated first-year total.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is included in the defaults?

Common first-year items: diapers, feeding, clothing, childcare, medical, and one-time gear. Edit everything to match your situation.

Does it include lost income?

No. It estimates out-of-pocket costs only, not unpaid leave or reduced earnings.

How accurate is this?

It is a planning estimate. Childcare alone varies enormously by city, so adjust the defaults.
